assessment_history.summary: This is a high-quality, well-structured PRD for the "Spec Landscape Awareness" feature. All four required spec sections are present and well-articulated. The Intent is clear and concise. The Background provides strong motivation with specific, concrete pain points. The Goals are measurable and tightly scoped. The Non-Goals draw explicit, sensible boundaries. Beyond the core spec sections, the document goes further with a detailed Technical Specification, verified external API references, and explicit Design Decisions — all of which meaningfully reduce ambiguity for implementers. The PRD is ready to proceed to artifact generation.
